description: dev-kit enforcement hooks (A18). Declared here, at the plugin level, because ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} does NOT resolve inside a project's own .claude/settings.json — a hook command built from it there is silently skipped, never run, not even with an empty value (measured on CLI 2.1.220, docs/BACKLOG.md A18). Declaring here is global: every matching tool call in EVERY repo the user has Claude Code open in reaches these scripts, not only repos this kit scaffolded. Each script's own first move is hook_opted_in() in hooks/_parse.sh, which exits 0 immediately unless the current repo has .claude/.framework-state.json — written by /project-init and scripts/upgrade.py to every repo this kit has actually touched.
